source.section: IV.C item 5 (PDF p.34, printed p.27); III.D.16 (PDF p.28)
source.quote_free_summary: The Chairman inspects marks after each heat and verifies correct transcription; only the Chairman and Scrutineer have direct access to the original marking sheets until the end of the competition.

requirement: The software records the Chairman's verification act; a generic scorer or manager is not assumed to qualify; original-sheet comparison is limited to the Chairman and Scrutineer roles.
interpretation_notes: The Scrutineer has no DanceFlow role and the chair-to-Chairman mapping is not approved (audit row J-01), so NDCA-declared events fail closed. The software cannot perform the physical comparison. Design only: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
